messages.text:
"A character is subjected to experiments designed to turn him into a monster. While inside a glass container filled with radioactive material, he transforms into a wolf, shatters the glass, and that’s how the game begins.
You have to escape from soldiers while taking them out; the character possesses a \"double jump\" ability, along with various movement and combat skills.
At the end of the path, there is a boss—if you manage to defeat him, the game is over.
The game is 2D for mobile devices and runs on low-end hardware.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

The opening shows the experiment pod breaking, then play continues through a facility escape with soldiers, a double jump, claw attacks, a ranged howl, a dash, and a final boss. It includes keyboard and touch controls, health and progress HUDs, and win/retry screens.

**Assumption:** The game is designed for landscape play on mobile. Graphics are drawn in Canvas with no external assets to keep it lightweight.

**Checked:** JavaScript syntax passes, and I opened the game in a browser to verify the scene and gameplay render.
